name: Answer chat questions with an AI agent using modular RAG
description: A chat AI agent that answers from your documents with a modular RAG pipeline. Each question is compressed with the conversation history, expanded into several search queries, matched against a vector store, and the retrieved passages are joined and added to the prompt before Anthropic answers.
shortDescription: A chat AI agent with a configurable, multi-step RAG pipeline over your vector store.
keyFeatures: Compression query transformer that folds the chat history into a standalone question
Multi-query expander that searches with three variations of the question plus the original
Vector store document retriever with a configurable top K and similarity threshold
Contextual query augmenter that adds the retrieved passages to the prompt
prerequisites: A vector store with your documents, attached to the Vector Store Document Retriever (the template leaves it empty)
idealFor: Developers who want to see each stage of a RAG pipeline and tune it, rather than use a single question-answer RAG element.
steps: AI Agent: rewrites and expands the question, retrieves matching passages from the vector store, joins them into the prompt and answers with Anthropic, remembering the conversation.
